column1: # P/02 implementation stages (ADR-0126; ADR-0125 addendum (5)): one possible plan, not a behavior norm.
# The installer is one-shot, with no HTTP door: no door or launch stage. The prior P/01 stand is available for puts and rights.
# gate is a semicolon-separated conjunction: verdicts:<chapter>:<case,...|*>, puts:<chapter>:<case,...|*>,
# verdicts/puts/accept select their own published table and judge; * is the full target including its published variants.
# seams selects scenarios of the seams.tsv of the chapter, run through the seam adapter (common acceptance README); the other checks keep their own judge.
# n is consecutive; depends names earlier n; weight is 1..5.
# - means none. Empty when means always applicable.
# The checklist retains the proof of units, install/upgrade, environment, TLS, CA, clients, the OS and real rollout/barriers.
# build confirms build only; the pure poll seams do not execute a rollout. Domain references in loader/rights remain whole inputs.
